newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stocks finish mixed, blue chips firmer.
newsitem.headline: KL stocks finish mixed, blue chips firmer.

text.p: Encouraged by a positive 1996 trade report and buoyed by buying in property-related stocks, the Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended firmer after a positive session.
The key index rose 6.10 points to 1,271.00. But trading in the Second Board index of smaller-capitalised shares was choppier, with the index ending off 3.16 points to 643.92.
In 1996, Malaysia reported a trade deficit of 617.97 million ringgit, down from 9.36 billion ringgit in 1995. The December trade balance showed a surplus of 872 million.
Economists said the trade position should improve more.
